readme.summary: Excellent clarity and installation guide with comprehensive API documentation, but lacks troubleshooting guidance and configuration examples for advanced use cases.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section for common issues like parsing failures, invalid robots.txt formats, or handling network errors when fetching remote robots.txt files

common_complaints: Incorrect parsing of robots.txt rules (isDisallowed behavior)
Poor input validation - accepts invalid/HTML content
URL handling issues (port addition, hostname mismatches)
